name: candidate-name
install_command: Record the exact project-local install command, such as python3 -m pip install <package> or the package-manager equivalent.
dependency_record_path: Record the dependency file or lock file that will track this install.
installation_record_path: Record the detailed audit record path under _history/installations/YYYY/.
environment_path: Record the project-local venv, tool runtime, plugin path, or global install path.
version_or_lock_status: Record exact version, version range, lock file, SBOM, or why none applies.
post_install_verification: Record the import, CLI, unit test, smoke test, or other verification that will run after install.
security_review: Record maintenance, vulnerability, provenance, or OpenSSF/CISA-style supply-chain checks.
license_review: Record license compatibility and attribution obligations.
rollback_plan: Record how to remove the package and restore tests if the install is rejected.
notes: Replace these placeholder scores after checking current project docs and repository activity.
